regime: Theory-finding for the exact normalization domain; conditional branch logic is a known-statement regime.
reason: Root-parent repair, containment repair and compound-root survival address distinct mechanisms. A failed formulation is not renamed and recycled as proved.

formulations.mechanism: A raw optimum can cut a compound cluster and an internal endpoint while containing no listed branch prefix.
Rejoined component overlaps another component in the target forest.
The incoming edge of an unlabelled component-root LCA does not exist.
All labels below the attached compound endpoint are disconnected from its root, so restoring the opposite path cut can join labels with the wrong upper topology.
The one-cut anchor controls rooted compatibility; full-path restoration and an actual-parent guard cover compound and absent-parent cases.
formulations.success_requirement: Universal graph/AF proof under stated hypotheses and fresh consumer review.

formulations.mechanism: Empty common roots require at least two internal cuts; restore the common subtree and cut its incoming edge for a strictly smaller AF. Requires a global current-forest minimum.
formulations.success_requirement: Strictly smaller genuine AF completion if the common pendant root fragment is empty.

limitations: Several corpus entries are source-domain obstructions rather than algorithm counterexamples.
The compound-empty counterexample is nonoptimal and structural; no reachability claim.
The root reached witness is nonoptimal and atom-respecting.
Feature choices are mechanism-driven after certified fires, not an exhaustive theorem-space synthesis.
Restricted universal AF arguments have two independent prose reviews; there is no kernel-formalized universal AF normalization theorem. General optimum/protected-origin lift remains open.
